name: Fireball
description:
Choose a point within long range. An explosive sphere of fire erupts at that point. Roll Spirit vs Dexterity against each creature within short range of the point. On a win, the creature takes 2d6 damage; on a loss, it takes half damage.

Release (Anger): +2d damage.

Describe the fireball.
successes:
✨: +1d6 damage

🌞: The blast instead reaches out to medium range.

💀: Check two conditions.
